# netbox_contact_roles (Data Source)

Lists NetBox contact role objects (`/api/tenancy/contact-roles/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_contact_roles" "all" {}

output "contact_roles" {
  value = data.netbox_contact_roles.all.items[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/tenancy/contact-roles/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name; validated against the parameters of the endpoint.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `display` (String) Display.
